note: Ground heights across the resort in metres above the middle pool deck, sampled by src/terrain.ts (each 2 m cell as two flat triangles split along its diagonal from the low-x, low-z corner). Generated by scripts/lidar_check.py grid from the PNOA-LiDAR 2020-21 ground model; do not edit by hand. Under houses and pools the cells are filled from the open ground around them; pool decks are held level. Inside the lowered main-pool area the grid holds the survey plus the drop, since the model draws that lawn LOWER_POOL_Y below the street and adds this grid. Seaward of the fade line (turned-frame z) the seafront heights take over and the grid fades to zero, as before.
source: PNOA-LiDAR (c) Instituto Geografico Nacional de Espana, CC BY 4.0, via REDIAM, Junta de Andalucia (2020-21 V226 MDT 1 m).

datum.meaning: survey ground at the middle pool deck, the model zero (orthometric metres)
